notes.title: 0.3.1 Demo Update
notes.content:
It's been about 3 months since we opened the demo build on March 19th. During this time, 1,600 players have played the demo through our Steam page and PlayX4 event. We're grateful to have received a lot of feedback, and based on all the feedback we've gathered, we've decided to update the demo once more.

The combat system has been comprehensively added to and improved, and a new mini dungeon has been added. The overall mood of the map has also been improved to create Graytail's unique atmosphere.

[h2]Combat Improvements[/h2]
We received a lot of feedback that combat was monotonous, so we added and improved systems to make combat more dynamic.
In the previous demo, enemies would simply follow the player in a line, making them easy to deal with. In the update, we've modified enemies to surround the protagonist. Also, enemies used to have their attacks canceled when hit, but now once they start an attack, it continues even if they get hit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/4d10b2a44a454186eaa8b87467187d8fcb051815.gif[/img]

In return, other features have been added for the player as well. First is lock-on. When you target an enemy with lock-on, the player character will face the targeted enemy regardless of which direction they move. This makes attacking easier since you don't need to manually turn directions for each attack. We've also added a parrying technique that deflects incoming enemy projectiles. You just need to swing your staff with the right timing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/282931941153bc6b3b2469cda9373dfe6e750e15.gif[/img]

We've also refined the existing auto-targeting system. While it's basically non-targeted by default, we've modified the targeting rules to provide only slight correction limited to enemies in the player's direction of movement.

[h2]New Mini Dungeon[/h2]
We received a lot of feedback that tension dropped at the beginning of the game because too much of the game's direction was concentrated in the early stages. So we've placed a small mini dungeon that provides about 10 minutes of gameplay after landing on the island, where players can learn the combat system mentioned above and experience the fun of puzzle gameplay.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/1b8b3ede040e8cc4f3478294795bc7e9d547f1aa.gif[/img]

[h2]Mood Improvements[/h2]
We've worked on improving the overall mood of the game so that our game's identity can be felt just from looking at screenshots, while maintaining the pixel art aesthetic.

First, the game's lighting has been improved. We've made this world feel more vibrant through effects like flowing clouds, sunbeams, and leaf shadows.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/dd8525e253492a8ea2ca0297f7ac7ec3941a5b82.gif[/img]

The village has been enhanced with broken cars and modern street lamps that fit the story. The protagonist's house has changed from a log cabin to a cool caravan that suits exploration. The chickens in the village, which couldn't be interacted with in the previous demo, can now be caught and thrown or used for gliding.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/8b27dac2265aec9c9c0036c6336db79f70e60e6d.gif[/img]

The atmosphere of the dungeons has also changed. The entrance to the mangrove area dungeon has been modified to feel more like a forgotten temple. The laboratory placed within the dungeon has also been enlarged compared to before, with new objects added.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/7839eafe285a3092c87d1f3a38f223067084db37.gif[/img]

[h2]Other Improvements[/h2]
Area names now display when moving to major locations. We've also fixed awkward dialogues throughout the game. Many minor bugs have been fixed as well.

[h2]Development and Release Plans[/h2]
As we have been doing so far, we plan to continue working hard on Graytail until completion.
We're changing our release approach from going through Early Access to releasing the complete game all at once. Since it's a story game, we feel that having it cut off in the middle wouldn't be a good experience. This means the time to introduce the game to you will be pushed back a bit. We expect to need about another year of work.

We apologize for the delay in the game's release.

We'll prepare well and meet you with a perfect version.

notes.title: PlayX4 Showcase & New Demo Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! This is SyntaxFossil and PixelRoseBud!
Graytail will be participating in 2025 PlayX4! Visitors will be the first to try out our new areas and puzzles we've been working on. We'll refine these puzzles based on your feedback at PlayX4 before adding them to future demo builds.

[h2]Finding Us at PlayX4[/h2]
You can check out Graytail at two locations during the event:
[list]
[*] Indie Game Room (Booth E10)
[*] 2025 Gyeonggi Game Audition Winners' Showcase
[/list]
We'll be there from May 22nd to 25th. Come by and give the game a try!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/5afca8ab88e6f8eaa52cbf69e5a018530d373747.png[/img]

[h2]Visual Enhancements[/h2]
We've enhanced the game's atmosphere for better immersion. You'll now see drifting cloud shadows on the beach and gentle leaf shadows moving through the forest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/f67bff12a48f1e9555d183bc8fb0177d5368d413.png[/img]

[h2]Combat Updates[/h2]
Based on your feedback about combat, we've implemented two new features:
[list]
[*] Target Lock: Now you can lock onto specific enemies during combat for more precise attacks and dodges.
[*] Ranged Parrying: Time your defenses right to deflect enemy projectiles - useful for defeating enemies or solving puzzles!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/5bd7b66e84500bf6796f5ede506f1ada96a9da3a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/09e6f9a143ce9dcff7cb86125a27daf1803e6860.png[/img]

We've also improved the enemy AI so multiple enemies will surround the player instead of just following in a line. Plus, once enemies begin an attack, your hits won't interrupt them anymore - so be strategic!

[h2]New Area: Lighthouse[/h2]
We've added a lighthouse between the island's beach and village. Beneath it lies an underground cave featuring an engaging combat tutorial and glimpses into the game's lore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/8b112e0659fe497eb3b0d99c309e2dfff741bfb0.png[/img]

[h2]Demo Update Preview[/h2]
After PlayX4, we plan to release an updated demo in June incorporating your feedback. We're adding early-game content that might change some of the later sections, so if you haven't played the demo yet, definitely check it out after the update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/46e9a891f3c9f8d1d1cf86ee960f57c00b805b5d.png[/img]

Adding us to your wishlist and following our progress really helps us as indie developers. Thanks for supporting our team and stay tuned for more development updates!

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello, we are SyntaxFossil and PixelRoseBud, the developers of Graytail.
Graytail's new demo has finally been released! This build contains the fruits of our development journey spanning over two years.
For us, this is an important milestone in our long development journey, and also an exciting moment as we await our first serious evaluation. To celebrate this special build, we'd like to share our project's story with you.

[h1]Kickoff (Month 0)[/h1]
In the summer of 2022, we began gathering ideas for our next project after our mobile game 'The Way Home'. Mobile or PC game? Roguelike or something else? We spent about 6 months contemplating our direction. Then, around winter, we happened to play 'The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap' and fell deeply in love with it, inspiring us to create a similar exploration-focused adventure game.
"Won't a year be enough?" In January 2023, we started with high spirits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/a9f92d0fef48ec247fd511df0592df293bf28225.gif[/img]
We thought it was fine back then...

[h1]Alpha Build (Month 14)[/h1]
It took over a year from the start of development to complete a playable build. Being unfamiliar with dungeon and field level design, our early work had many issues: repetitive, too difficult, lacking distinctive features... We repeated the process of erasing maps and redrawing them, barely preparing a build in time for game shows and contests.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/ea447832e78ac0613306156c46e336d69e37a9d4.jpg[/img]

[h1]Bosses (Month 18)[/h1]
We put a lot of effort into creating bosses, which were absent from our first demo. We wanted to make bosses with special strategies, not just big and powerful enemies. We wanted to deliver the same sense of awe we felt facing Zelda's bosses, if not more, in our game. We spent over a month on implementing each boss.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/b5b9faae37c0e703a64feb65b0a5483903176810.gif[/img]
Worm boss under development
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/7eebece9d8c879b278ebb62fe21d128638f551b5.png[/img]
Mostly discarded boss concept art...

[h1]Official Demo Build (Month 26)[/h1]
Implementing puzzles, action, and adventure elements well while also taking care of the narrative was truly challenging. Sometimes we doubted whether two people could handle it all, but we didn't want to give up on any aspect. That's why this build is especially meaningful to us.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/2fabd5aeb5d8f92129f7eb6e395ca82f7567450e.png[/img]
In this demo, you can play through Chapter 1 (excluding side dungeons) up to the first boss, with an estimated playtime of about 1 hour. There are still bugs, gaps, and areas for improvement throughout the game. If you leave feedback in the discussion forum after playing, it would be a tremendous help to us.

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.content:
Hello! We are developers MJ and SH! It has already been three months since the last development update. During this time, we’ve been working hard on the game. We’ll share what has been worked on, and at the end of this post, we’ll share our schedule as well.

[h2]Chapter 2 Mini-Boss - Death Worm[/h2]
The mini-boss appearing in Chapter 2, Death Worm, is a long and massive worm that performs fast charging attacks. This creature can burrow into the ground, making it difficult for the protagonist to avoid attacks. When its body is severed, it splits into two smaller worms and continues attacking, making the battle increasingly complex.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/b2970084b28006753e6cc018441ef96fd7c671b5.png[/img]

[h2]Chapter 2 Main Boss - Excavator[/h2]
The Chapter 2 boss, Excavator, is a massive machine equipped with two giant saw blades. It's incredibly powerful and durable, so it cannot be defeated with external attacks alone. The player must infiltrate the machine's interior to destroy it, where an unexpected meeting with a special character awaits.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/b730d3d062a8ec18ffa03d106c1c2688dba63475.png[/img]

[h2]Hot Air Balloon[/h2]
When a flare is shot, an NPC safety officer from the village arrives in a hot air balloon and takes the protagonist back to the village. The hot air balloon can be used to quickly return to the village and can also be used for a tour around the village.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/1991848b0088ebd7c209e021842dac4cf05ac0d2.png[/img]

[h2]Wiring System[/h2]
A new puzzle element using electrical plugs has been added to the game. Players need to plug and unplug the plugs into outlets to solve puzzles. For example, players can use the plugs to rotate fans or activate certain mechanical devices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/df3274798a30689644748b0b00d648b81aee1a52.png[/img]

[h2]Rail System[/h2]
A new system has been added where players can ride a minecart along rails to move quickly. This system allows players to safely pass through dangerous areas, like lava fields. Players will need to switch the direction of the rails to solve puzzles and continue their exploration.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/2c6cef7d6757a7d769a33e6012f011e4342412a3.png[/img]

[h2]Platform and Saw Blade Traps[/h2]
Platforms and dangerous saw blade traps along the rails have also been added. Players can use platforms to explore deeper parts of the dungeon. The saw blade traps are fast and powerful, so players must be cautious.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/1eeada7cdb15f108d8969d8144b857ace67804f6.png[/img]

[h2]Bike Improvements[/h2]
Lighting has been added to support night riding. Various new night content is also being prepared.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/47a5b2d37143f56b4fc1fa858de776cb69446181.png[/img]

[h2]Additional Monsters[/h2]
Various monsters, including saw blade machines and frogs from Chapter 1’s additional area, have been added. Each monster has its own unique traits, and players will need to use the appropriate strategies to defeat them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/912e29dcde5ed4edda7b62d4cffcf24e92fd9110.png[/img]

[h2]Reactive Water System[/h2]
A realistic water ripple effect has been added for situations like falling into water, boats passing by, or swimming.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/99905fab43d8bfb400c72a7f9147c03d4ac3388b.png[/img]

[h2]Village[/h2]
Several new buildings have been added to the village, including a shop selling ingredients and an astrologer's house. New NPCs, such as the shopkeeper, fisherman, astrologer, and safety officer, have enriched the village environment.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/1584313ad90e068fcd17ec0b104ed692183dc68b.png[/img]

[h2]Cooking System[/h2]
A new cooking system has been added, allowing players to prepare various dishes based on recipes. Each dish provides special effects, such as health recovery, poison treatment, or even revival after death. However, if the recipe is wrong, a ruined dish will result, and consuming it may cause food poisoning. As players progress, they will learn more recipes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/97db8134491c4f78240307a34ddfe5e15eb31faf.png[/img]

[h2]Lab Area[/h2]
A new facility has been added near the boss room, where the boss was studied. This area contains various information and materials about the boss, providing crucial insights into its weaknesses. It’s an important location to explore the game's story and lore, and it’s essential for preparing for the boss fight.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/7a9cc23778dfdc3dfd8c4fa4ba51834a57e912c6.png[/img]

[h2]Multilingual Support[/h2]
The game now supports 17 languages! The following languages are available:  
- Korean  
- English  
- Japanese  
- Simplified Chinese  
- Traditional Chinese  
- German  
- French  
- Russian  
- Portuguese (Brazil)  
- Spanish  
- Italian  
- Polish  
- Swedish  
- Turkish  
- Thai  
- Vietnamese  
- Indonesian

[h2]Schedule Update[/h2]
The demo version is scheduled to be released in the second quarter of 2025. After the demo release, feedback will be incorporated for improvements, and the Early Access version will be launched in the third quarter of 2025. The Early Access version will include about 50% of the content, covering 3 chapters. The Early Access release has been delayed by one quarter from the original plan. We apologize for the schedule delay 😭 We are working hard to deliver a great game!

notes.title: Devlogs #1
notes.content:
Hello,

We’re MJ and SH, the creators of Graytail. Nice to meet you! 🤠

We’re a two-person development team, and we’ve been working on this game for two years. We’re planning to release it in early access in the first half of next year. For those who are eagerly awaiting the game, we’d like to occasionally share our development journey through our official Steam channel here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/62cf9a94293ead7406dca08f0515a2504ba1088a.png[/img]



Alright, let’s get started!
Here are the key updates we've worked on since the last update to our Steam page.


[h3][b]A bike has been added! 🛵[/b][/h3]
As the world map has expanded, we needed a fast travel option. You can unlock it after clearing Chapter 1. It allows for quick travel and you can also use a booster for a short period. Additionally, you can use kicker ramp to reach higher places!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/35888d183b1398e61895a4713bf25357ff5dc04e.gif[/img]


[h3][b]The design for Chapter 1's field is complete! 🌊[/b][/h3]
Inspired by the Nan Madol region of Micronesia, we've created a coastal area with mangrove trees. We’ve also added shallow water areas and made shaders to make the water effects appear natural.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/04b62a8d229ac73dd3a084bb81f00f8810d5b667.gif[/img]


[h3][b]A sub-boss has been added in Chapter 1! 🔥[/b][/h3]
He’s a character that unleashes powerful fire-breathing attacks. The graffiti he’s left on the walls is quite intriguing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/859cb8cd91d8e7629921b7eb5680333842222821.gif[/img]


[h3][b]We’re currently designing the field for Chapter 2! 🪜[/b][/h3]
Chapter 2 features a high mountainous region with cliffs scattered throughout. We’re adding devices and gimmicks to make the exploration more interesting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/41db429947d97985b9367572735258a1cfb01ae8.gif[/img]


[h3][b]You can use bombs and pickaxes! ⛏️🧨[/b][/h3]
You can use them to break lightweight blocks or attack enemies. You can also pick up bombs and throw them from a distance!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/96915a7c0129767973eb3cea063e7a2fb76ebce3.gif[/img]


[h3][b]We’re creating mobs for Chapter 2! 🕷️[/b][/h3]
We’re creating enemies with distinctive gimmicks. Each one behaves differently, making the encounters enjoyable as you face them one by one!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/45f3f4b1285f65ebf88b299f8e5876f3bdd34367.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/5a6f44eaab66e87b2c928b8073ed0a3aebf116f2.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/ad81693d242fdb822a7da5a7f16701d6d70ab45b.gif[/img]


[h3][b]The shop system has been completed! 🏪[/b][/h3]
The items at the shop are sold out once purchased, and they will be restocked after a certain amount of time. If you visit the shop at night, you might find different items for sale. While this shop primarily sells bombs, we plan to add other shops in the village that will offer different products in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/c62851b648bfe7134e56401200f8be7dc4702dfa.gif[/img]


[h3][b]There will be hidden spaces! 🗿[/b][/h3]
There will be hidden spaces throughout the map that are not easy to find. While you won’t need to discover them to progress in the game, we’ve prepared special rewards for those who do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/3cf5c6e8fdc8abf7b656f120eb1044823b572644.gif[/img]


[h3][b]You’ll need to select all of the protagonist’s dialogue! 💬[/b][/h3]
Depending on your choices, NPCs will respond differently. Some decisions will have long-lasting effects in the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44931949/eded7f6027bf0c2f87d797c7a519da6e7b803ef0.gif[/img]


Many other additions and improvements have also been made. You can check out the rest in the early access build! 🤠

We’ll prepare more and see you in the next development update!
